After graduate school, Sandra embarked on a career as an organizational communication consultant. And, she turned her talents into a successful academic writing career. Her co-authored book, Business and Professional Communication in the Global Workplace, now in its third edition, was based on her consulting work with Fortune 500 companies. But fiction still called to her. Over the past ten years, she has written a chick lit series based on detective wantabee, C.C. Maxwell.
